issue_context.body:

## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened instead.
-->
When sending harmony hub commands using remote.send_command, there's a lag of about 1 seconds even if a lower value is used for delay_secs such as .001.  However, if you send a command with delay_secs set to something higher than 1 such as 5 seconds, the delay is 5 seconds.  The previous version where there was no lag was 0.105.5.


## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant release with the issue: 0.106.0b0 through 0.106.5
- Last working Home Assistant release (if known): 0.105.5
- Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.): Docker
- Integration causing this issue: Harmony
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/harmony

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
remote:
  - platform: harmony
    name: Family
    host: 192.168.30.22
```

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt

```

## Additional information
comments: Hey there @ehendrix23, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`harmony`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L144) for? Thanks!
I rolled back to 0.106.0b0 and the problem is present there as well.

I just noticed the same issue, I'm running .106.5 currently.

I don't see any changes in the Harmony specific code that could have caused this, I think it's something upstream that's limiting the frequency of service calls for some reason. #33394 looks like a similar issue with the Onkyo integration.
Looking at the history of homeassistant/helpers/service.py, it looks like #31454 is a possible cause, but I can't say for certain.
Yes.   It has something to do with significant changes to services.py.   https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/32671
@KHouse75 Yeah, that's the code I had zeroed in on as well. Didn't catch that other issue already open, thanks for linking it.
Yes.  It's still an issue in 0.108.x.

@KHouse75 

I've got a potential fix that needs to be tested which can be installed in `custom_components` if you would like to try it.

Step 1:
Add the following to your configuration.yaml
```
logger:
  default: info
  logs:
      custom_components.harmony: debug
```

Step 2

```
cd /config
mkdir custom_components
cd custom_components
git clone https://github.com/bdraco/harmony
```

Step 3:
Restart

I gave the new code a try but I'm still seeing the delay between commands.   The first command always sends immediately.  If I send multiple commands back to back, there's at least a 1 second delay.  If I wait a second or so and send another command, it's immediate.

Here's the log.  I left the defaults so there's a .4 second delay between commands.  You can see that's there's at least a second delay between commands, however.  Hard to get the exact delay because it only logs to the second and not millisecond.
